name: Precision Cron Scheduler
summary: In-memory precision job scheduler with drift compensation, jitter, and retry backoff
description:
## Precision Cron Scheduler

A resilient, memory-efficient background task runner featuring millisecond drift correction, configurable randomized jitter to prevent thundering herd spikes, and automated exponential backoff on failure.

### Highlights
- Interval and recurring timer execution with drift compensation
- Randomized jitter window to spread API bursts
- Execution history ring buffer and success/failure metrics
- Graceful cancellation and cleanup
- Zero external runtime dependencies
